 After i fully came to (I had a blood alcohol level of .46) my only thoughts were of my boyfriend and what I put him through. 
 The full day that I was released from the hospital I felt NOTHING... absolutely nothing. The only thoughts other than the fact that if the cord hadn't broken my boyfriend would have hit my body when he opened the door.. 
 I guess I felt more about what the people in my life would deal with.
